scripts.build: cp packages/backend/prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma packages/backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma generate --schema=packages/backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --workspace=packages/backend && npm run build --workspace=packages/bot
scripts.start: npx prisma db push --schema=packages/backend/prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss && node packages/backend/dist/index.js & node packages/bot/dist/index.js
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace=packages/backend && npm run build --workspace=packages/bot
scripts.build:railway: cp packages/backend/prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma packages/backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma generate --schema=packages/backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --workspace=packages/backend && npm run build --workspace=packages/bot
scripts.start:prod: npx prisma db push --schema=packages/backend/prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss && node packages/backend/dist/index.js & node packages/bot/dist/index.js
